text:
```yaml
name: Claude MD Check

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'CLAUDE.md'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'CLAUDE.md'

jobs:
  check-claude-md-size:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check CLAUDE.md size
        run: |
          MAX_CHARS=25000
          if [ ! -f "CLAUDE.md" ]; then
            echo "CLAUDE.md not found"
            exit 0
          fi
          
          CHAR_COUNT=$(wc -m < CLAUDE.md)
          echo "CLAUDE.md character count: $CHAR_COUNT"
          
          if [ "$CHAR_COUNT" -gt "$MAX_CHARS" ]; then
            echo "::error::CLAUDE.md exceeds maximum size of $MAX_CHARS characters (current: $CHAR_COUNT)"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "CLAUDE.md size is within limits ($CHAR_COUNT/$MAX_CHARS characters)"
          fi
```
